=Tags=

Examples are either tagged with [http://loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php a language] or [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet_chart_for_English_dialects English dialect]. Any example that is not tagged is considered "General American" (GA).

Tags currently used:

* (RP) = Received Pronunciation (Standard in the United Kingdom)
* (ScE) = Scottish English
* (spa) = spanish
* (≈) = almost equal to
